altText: Taylor Swift photo: Taylor Swift Eras Tour
body: she's singing at the CMAs TONIGHT and my hands are literally shaking 😭 her first time on that stage since 2013, when she slowed "Red" down with Alison Krauss. 8pm ET on ABC and i will be screaming at my tv https://www.longlivets.com/?era=the-life-of-a-showgirl&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=news
why: Nov 18 CMA pre-show beat, X half written first as its own post: the nerves first, then the one anchoring fact (first CMA performance since 2013's acoustic "Red"). Sourced: GMA (2026-11-13) and Showbiz Junkies report Taylor performing at the 60th CMA Awards, Wed Nov 18, 8pm ET on ABC and Disney+ from Bridgestone Arena; last CMA performance 2013 ("Red" with Alison Krauss, Vince Gill et al.); nominated Single of the Year for "I Knew It, I Knew You". Intake #6840 was the lead only. No CMA moment in the Vault yet (#6891), so the era link. Pre-show only: no setlist, no performance described.

critique.rationale: Leads with the fan nerves two hours before she performs, then one checkable fact: her first CMA performance since the 2013 acoustic "Red" with Alison Krauss. Time-bound to tonight and links to the Showgirl era.
